_purpose: Machine-readable map from every FIXTURE-class test case across the discovered docs/qa/*_test_cases.md documents to the committed input it needs. A FIXTURE case means: invoke the named agent (via the Agent tool) against the committed `fixture` path and check the output against `expect`. Each entry names the QA document it belongs to via `qaDoc` (case IDs are reused independently across documents, so `(qaDoc, id)` — not `id` alone — is the unit of identity). This manifest does NOT execute any case — scripts/ci/validate-fixture-manifest.js only proves each case's committed input still exists, is wired to a real agent definition, and that every discovered document with FIXTURE cases has at least one manifest entry pointing at it. Running a FIXTURE case still requires a human, or a future eval harness, to actually invoke the agent and read what comes back.
_fixture_field_note: `fixture` is a repo-relative path (file or directory), an array of repo-relative paths when a single test case is defined over more than one committed input, or `null` when the QA document names no committed input for that case (a `note` field is then required explaining what is missing).
